name: Short Course - POST and Approve, Expected End Date Falls Into 26/27, No Claims
description: SLD POSTs a short course starting in AY 25/26 (2026-06-01) with an expected end date that falls into AY 26/27 (2026-09-30), no milestones claimed. Employer approves it. No PUT, no milestone claims. Variant of `post-approve-no-claims` with the expected end date crossing the AY boundary rather than staying within AY 25/26. Also queries the AY 26/27 short course earnings endpoint and asserts only the 2627 completion earning is returned — not the 2526 ThirtyPercentLearningComplete milestone earning. **Gap story — currently fails**: the endpoint returns both the 2627 LearningComplete earning and a leaked 2526 ThirtyPercentLearningComplete earning that was never claimed.

assertions.name: AY 26/27 earnings response returns the 2627 completion earning
AY 26/27 earnings response does not also return the unclaimed 2526 milestone earning
